resource_envelope.scope: The two conditions share the same limits. This isolated diagnostic requests one next-action response after equal CPU calibration; unused permission is not measured usage or a Goal limit.

calibration_selection_rationale: Host-selected before this diagnostic: an unregularized low-degree anchor and a heavily regularized higher-degree comparison. These are not LLM-selected configurations. Registered improvement criteria are independently evaluated and do not guarantee success/failure records in every unit.
design_units: meaningful_gain and precision_halfwidth are absolute paired duplicate-proportion differences; .10 means 10 percentage points, not a relative decrease
pilot_design: Nine distinct-seed paired units derive from ceil(2/.5^2)+1 under the frozen normal-variance planning approximation; each of three development regimes contributes three. This is a diagnostic pilot requirement, not a cap on research loops. Discrete paired outcomes and unknown model sampling seeds require independent review before confirmatory design.
status: Example only; no registration, actual model collection or memory-effect assertion has been performed.
